The championship phase concluded on 20 May 2026, with [[Zamalek SC]] securing their 15th league title following a 1–0 victory over [[Ceramica Cleopatra FC|Ceramica Cleopatra]] in the final round.{{cite web |url=https://www.masrawy.com/sports/sports_news/details/2026/5/20/2991376/ |title=الزمالك بطلاً للدوري الممتاز للموسم 2025-2026 بعد فوزه على سيراميكا |publisher=Masrawy |date=20 May 2026 |access-date=21 May 2026 |language=ar}} Zamalek clinched the championship after a fierce race with [[Pyramids FC]], finishing at the top of the championship group with 56 points, a two-point margin ahead of Pyramids who finished as runners-up with 54 points.{{cite web |url=https://www.kooora.com/%D9%83%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D9%82%D8%AF%D9%85/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1/bltd988afe84cbae59c |title=الزمالك يتوج بالدوري المصري للمرة 15 في تاريخه متفوقاً على بيراميدز بفارق نقطتين |publisher=Kooora |date=20 May 2026 |access-date=21 May 2026 |language=ar}} Meanwhile, the relegation phase continues until 27 May to determine the remaining two teams to be relegated alongside Ismaily and Pharco. ==Format== On 18 May 2025, the Egyptian Pro League Association announced the cancellation of relegation for the 2024–25 season.{{cite web |url=https://www.kingfut.com/2025/05/18/major-egyptian-premier-league-reforms-no-relegation-expanded-league-for-next-season/ |title=Major Egyptian Premier League Reforms: No Relegation, Expanded League for Next Season |publisher=KingFut |date=18 May 2025 }} Three teams were promoted to the Premier League, increasing the size of the league from 18 to 21 teams.{{cite web |url=https://www.youm7.com/story/2025/8/8/قبل-انطلاق-الإيجبشيان-ليج-تعرف-على-نظام-الدوري-المصري-بالنسخة/7082293 |title=قبل انطلاق الإيجبشيان ليج.. تعرف على نظام الدوري المصري بالنسخة الجديدة |publisher=youm7.com |language=ar |date=8 August 2025 }} The league consists of 21 teams in a single group and is played in two phases. In the first phase, teams face each other once in a single-leg tie, after which the league splits into two groups. Phase two features a championship group for the teams finishing first to seventh and a relegation group for teams placed eighth to twenty-first. The first-place team in the championship group is crowned league champion and qualifies for the [[CAF Champions League]] alongside the runner-up, while the third-place team qualifies for the [[CAF Confederation Cup]]. Four of the teams in the relegation group get relegated to the [[Egyptian Second Division A]] at the end of the season.{{cite web |title=Egyptian Premier League 2025/26: Draw Date and New Format Revealed |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/article/egyptian-premier-league-2025-26-171300165.html |website=sports.yahoo.com |publisher=yahoo!sports |access-date=9 August 2025}} ==Teams== {{Location map+|Egypt|width=450|float=right|caption=Locations of the 2025–26 Egyptian Premier League teams|places= {{location map~|Egypt|lat=30.050001|long=31.233333|label_size=80|label=[[Greater Cairo]]|mark=Blue pog.svg|position=bottom}} {{Location map~|Egypt|lat=30.967664|long=31.168495|label=[[Ghazl El Mahalla SC|Ghazl]]|position=bottom}} {{Location map~|Egypt|lat=27.360154|long=33.659431|label=[[El Gouna FC|El Gouna]]|position=right}} {{Location map~|Egypt|lat=31.200580|long=29.901614|label=[[Haras El Hodoud SC|Haras]]|position=right}} {{Location map~|Egypt|lat=30.601739|long=32.284237|label=[[Ismaily SC|Ismaily]]|position=right}} {{Location map~|Egypt|lat=31.208673|long=29.917367|label=[[Al Ittihad Alexandria Club|Al Ittihad]]|position=left}} {{Location map~|Egypt|lat=30.402291|long=32.308979|label=[[Kahraba Ismailia SC|Kahraba]]|position=right}} {{Location map~|Egypt|lat=31.242483|long=32.290401|label=[[Al Masry SC|Al Masry]]|position=top}} {{Location map~|Egypt|lat=29.969031|long=32.513113|label=[[Petrojet SC|Petrojet]]|position=bottom}} {{Location map~|Egypt|lat=31.022909|long=29.787724|label=[[Pharco FC|Pharco]]|position=bottom}} {{Location map~|Egypt|lat=31.215483|long=29.951406|label=[[Smouha SC|Smouha]]|position=top}} {{Location map~|Egypt|mark=TransparentPlaceholder.png|marksize=1|lat=26.5|long=25|label=
